firm_data.firm_description: Scaffidi & Associates is a New York City-based law firm with a reputation for tenacious litigation and skilled negotiation, providing comprehensive legal services to individuals and businesses throughout the greater New York City area, Connecticut, and New Jersey. The firm focuses on medical malpractice, personal injury, real estate, and business law.
notable_facts: The firm has recovered over three-quarters of a billion dollars for their clients.
Roy Scaffidi has been recognized as one of the top trial lawyers in New York City and the country.
The firm has an unparalleled reputation for understanding and analyzing medicine in complicated cases.

email.subject: AI for Scaffidi & Associates, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Roy,

Your firm's track record of recovering over three-quarters of a billion dollars for clients speaks to the caliber of litigation you handle, particularly in medical malpractice where case complexity demands both precision and deep case analysis.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on complex litigation.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
